description: Defines the 'config_file' class with nested structures for logging and master/slave configuration parameters, including static methods for reading configuration files.

classes.name: config_file
classes.description: Class providing static methods and nested structures for handling configuration files in the beerocks namespace.

methods.name: read_config_file
methods.description: Reads a configuration file into a vector of tuples based on the specified config type.

methods.name: read_master_config_file
methods.description: Reads master configuration parameters from a file into sConfigMaster structure.

methods.name: read_slave_config_file
methods.description: Reads slave configuration parameters from a file into sConfigSlave structure.
